name: clipboard-case
title: Clipboard Case
description: Change clipboard text case, trim whitespace, or collapse text to one line and paste it instantly.
author: paul_barrass

commands.name: paste-lowercase
commands.title: Paste as Lowercase
commands.description: Convert clipboard text to lowercase and paste it into the active app.

commands.name: paste-uppercase
commands.title: Paste as Uppercase
commands.description: Convert clipboard text to uppercase and paste it into the active app.

commands.name: paste-sentence-case
commands.title: Paste as Sentence Case
commands.description: Lowercase clipboard text, capitalize sentence and line beginnings, and paste it.

commands.name: paste-title-case
commands.title: Paste as Title Case
commands.description: Capitalize each word in clipboard text and paste it into the active app.

commands.name: paste-trimmed
commands.title: Trim Whitespace and Paste
commands.description: Remove whitespace from the start and end of clipboard text, then paste it.

commands.name: paste-one-line
commands.title: Paste as One Line
commands.description: Collapse line breaks, tabs, and repeated spaces to single spaces, then paste it.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
